data.content_ref: inline:The target fails to propose a substantive relation as required because the 'REFUTED IF' clause describes an internal vulnerability of the integrated concept (verisimilitude) rather than defining the integration relation itself. The prompt explicitly states that 'a summary of the endpoints is not a relation'; similarly, stating the conditions under which the integration would fail (the refutation condition) without positively articulating the mechanism, dependency, or logical structure of the integration between SRC_005 and SRC_003 constitutes a description of the endpoints' risks, not the relational bond connecting them.
